versions.subject: rule to detect mimikatz lsadump::changentlm and lsadump::setntlm
versions.detection:
samrpipe:
        - EventLog: Security
          EventID: 5145
          RelativeTargetName: samr
passwordchanged:
        - EventLog: Security
          EventID: 4738
          PasswordLastSet: (any) 
timeframe: 15s 
condition: samrpipe and passwordchanged
versions.spl: EventLog="Security" EventID=5145 RelativeTargetName="samr" EventLog="Security" EventID=4738 PasswordLastSet="(any)"
